newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Sime Darby 96/97 Q3 net 95.443 mln pesos.
newsitem.headline: Sime Darby 96/97 Q3 net 95.443 mln pesos.

text.p: Sime Darby Pilipinas Inc said on Wednesday it posted a net income of 95.443 milion pesos in the third quarter ended March.
The profit figure was a turnaround from a loss of 164.848 million pesos reported in the year-ago period, the company told the Philippine Stock Exchange.
Sime Darby has interests in rubber plantations, manufacturing and property development.
The company said net sales in the 1996/97 third quarter were 19.155 million pesos compared to the year-ago 254.17 million.
It said the latest third quarter profits were higher despite weaker sales numbers because it earned an interest income of 143.421 million pesos compared to 17.188 million a year-ago.
Expenses were lower at 49.617 million pesos as against 362.321 million a year-ago.
